content.title: About
content.content: Soup Noodle NFS is a ready‑to‑eat dry soup that contains noodles, seasoning and dried vegetable pieces. When hot water is added it turns into a flavorful hot soup, convenient for travel or work.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soup Noodle NFS was first launched in 1998 as part of a fast‑food line.
The mix often includes microscopic pieces of carrot, onion and celery that retain some vitamins after drying.
Polydextrose is used so the noodles keep their shape even after long storage.
Variants with chicken, beef, tomato and spicy flavors are produced in different countries.
The package is designed for a single serving (about 250 ml of prepared soup).

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: Carbohydrates in the noodles provide a rapid source of energy, useful when time is limited.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Dried vegetables and spices supply vitamin B6 and niacin, supporting metabolism.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: Most variants contain no added fat, making them suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salt in the blend helps maintain electrolyte balance, especially in hot weather.

items.title: Convenience and portability
items.content: Easy to store and prepare without refrigeration or complex kitchen equipment.

items.title: High sodium level
items.content: The salt may be an issue for people with hypertension; consider reducing added salt.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The noodles usually contain wheat; the product is not suitable for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Some versions may contain flavor enhancers (MSG), which can cause reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Heat preparation
items.content: Insufficiently heated soup may retain bacteria if the water was not boiling.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour 250 ml of boiling water over the packet contents, cover, and let steep for 3–5 minutes. Optionally add fresh vegetables, herbs or cooked meat pieces to boost nutrition.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the package tightly sealed to prevent moisture absorption.
